decisions.title: Sign or reject the endless hazard product contract
decisions.ask: Sign or reject the endless hazard contract (obstacles, enemies and items in phases)?
decisions.recommendation: Read the draft and sign it if you still want difficulty to come from hazards: it is the only lever past level 268 that keeps zoom and board size frozen.
decisions.context: The draft contract for obstacles, enemies and items is unsigned; five cards are covered by it.

decisions.title: Decide what happens past level 198 so levels keep getting harder
decisions.ask: After level 268, is the lever for endless difficulty hazards (the same decision as signing MAZER-HAZ-002) or a bigger board?
decisions.recommendation: Hazards: you ruled out zoom and board size, and without a new lever the ladder plateaus at 268.
decisions.context: The ladder ends at level 268; the lever after that is a product call.

decisions.title: Tell sign-up users their username shows on the leaderboard: live, phone check open
decisions.ask: Confirm the sign-up line copy (This username shows on the Mazer leaderboard.) and look at it once on your phone.
decisions.context: PR #124 is merged and live (headless readback of the sign-up screen); the owner has not confirmed the copy and nothing is checked on a phone.

verify.step: Open the account-site Create Account screen on your phone.
verify.expected: The line This username shows on the Mazer leaderboard. is visible before you submit; a duplicate sign-up notice appears as its own line, not in the button label.

decisions.title: Account-site sign-out no longer races to login: merged, not live until aliases move
decisions.ask: Should signing out on the account site also end the Mazer session?
decisions.recommendation: Fix the race first; decide the session question as a separate step.
decisions.context: The race fix needs no decision, but whether account-site sign-out should also end the Mazer session is a design choice.

decisions.title: Username sign-in lockout (v4) live and sign-in verified; v5 proposal open, not applied
decisions.ask: Review the v5 proposal (FawxzzyWeb PR #133) and decide whether its exact SQL may be applied.
decisions.recommendation: Review the differences from live v4 first; nothing is applied until you approve the exact SQL.
decisions.context: v4 is live and a coordinator sign-in check passed. FawxzzyWeb PR #133 (v5) is an open proposal: failures-only check and record, keyed by username and client, no forwarded-address header; its SQL is not applied.

decisions.title: Resolve the duplicate-username collisions with the oldest account winning
decisions.ask: Flip the pair_extension_recorded flag in file 05 and approve its hash.
decisions.recommendation: Oldest account wins; the others keep email sign-in.
decisions.context: The resolution changes which account keeps a public username.

decisions.title: Provide approved app icon art with proper corners and a clean screenshot capture route
decisions.ask: Provide approved app icon art with proper corners (or say to keep the current icon).
decisions.recommendation: Supply a master without baked corners; the build agent then regenerates the icons, the hash verifier and clean screenshots.
